citywide_summary.restriction_level: Level 1 Water Restrictions (Proposed 15% Demand Reduction; No daytime irrigation 06:00–18:00)
citywide_summary.active_network_action: Technical teams releasing trapped air from pipelines to clear airlocks restricting flow to high ridges; targeted pressure management active.

grand_central.verified_bulletin: Grand Central Reservoir remains very low; pumping to the Grand Central Tower is suspended. High-lying ridges (Waterfall Heights, Bekker Rd, Halfway House) experience dry taps and 18h–24h airlock recovery lag.

erand.verified_bulletin: Erand Reservoir is at ~35% capacity with its outlet fully open, improving supply to Kyalami, Noordwyk, and Vorna Valley lowlands, though bulk inflows from Palmiet remain constrained.

president_park.verified_bulletin: President Park Reservoir is at ~67%, but elevated zones in Ivory Park, Ebony Park, Allandale, and Kaalfontein continue to experience low pressure during peak draw-off.

diepsloot.verified_bulletin: Supply constrained by northern bulk demand; high-lying Diepsloot West experiences evening pressure drops.

rabie_ridge.verified_bulletin: Midrand system under high demand strain; upper Rabie Ridge experiences intermittent pressure during peak hours.

brixton.verified_bulletin: New Brixton 1 Reservoir is at ~91% with outlet fully open; Brixton 2 is at ~50%. Actively supporting neighbouring Hursthill and Crosby zones.

hursthill.verified_bulletin: Leaking Hursthill 2 remains bypassed for structural repairs; Hursthill 2 interlink opened further to feed Crosby, Brixton, and Hursthill. High ridges (Melville, Parktown West, Westbury) face severe airlocks and low pressure.

crosby.verified_bulletin: Crosby Reservoir remains constrained under Commando system recovery; receiving supplemental flow via the Hursthill 2 interlink.

linden.verified_bulletin: Randburg system recovering gradually; high ridges in Robin Hills and Linden experience intermittent supply while airlocks are bled.

northcliff.verified_bulletin: Northcliff system under pressure management; upper summit streets experience delayed recovery after nightly throttling.

honeydew.verified_bulletin: Honeydew continues to experience very low inflows and reservoir levels despite slight overnight improvement. Sundowner, Northriding, and Northgate remain affected; Cosmo City Ext 0 throttling lifted.

morningside.status_label: SANDTON AT 37% — PUMP STATIONS ON BYPASS
morningside.verified_bulletin: Storage across Sandton systems improved overnight from 27% to 37%, but levels remain low. Bryanston and Illovo pumping stations are operating on bypass; high ridges remain under active management.

crown_gardens.verified_bulletin: Crown Gardens Reservoir and Tower are both at 100% capacity and supplying water normally; Meredale throttling lifted.

clifton_centurion.verified_bulletin: Tshwane Region 4 (Centurion) reservoirs under Rand Water consumption cap; high-lying ridges in The Reeds and Eldoraigne experience evening pressure drops.

garsfontein.verified_bulletin: Garsfontein reservoir stable at 62%; Waterkloof Ridge upper streets monitored during peak evening draw-off.

bedfordview_ridge.verified_bulletin: Bedfordview and Edenvale supply stabilizing following Palmiet booster pressure regulation; upper Kloof Rd ridge experiences slight pressure dip.

kempton_park.verified_bulletin: Kempton Park reservoir operating normally with steady inflows.

benoni.verified_bulletin: Northmead and Benoni systems holding at 46%; minor low pressure on Northmead ridge during peak evening draw.

krugersdorp_ridge.verified_bulletin: Mogale City high-lying Noordheuwel ridge recovering following Eikenhof pumping stabilization.
